structured_output.what_is_happening: A same-name copy of Effective Accelerationism (e/acc) was deployed straight onto PumpSwap about 12 minutes before detection, with no pump.fun bonding curve. It uses the same Beff Jezos tweet link as its social. The real e/acc token (CbcyNo7) launched about 4.5 hours earlier and is at roughly $17.6M market cap with about $520k liquidity on PumpSwap. This copy went up about 225% to a $35k market cap on $200k of volume. It is a spillover/copycat trade riding the main coin's pump.

narrative.description: e/acc (effective accelerationism) is Beff Jezos' movement. A coin under that name, apparently tied to a @beffjezos post, is trending hard at around $17.6M market cap.
narrative.why_spreading: The main token is surging and linked to a well-known tech figure's tweet. The attention belongs to the canonical CbcyNo7 token, not to this copy.

token_connection.why_this_token: Only the shared name/ticker and a copied tweet link connect it. It launched 4.5 hours after the canonical coin, as a direct PumpSwap pool with unlocked LP.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN tags 55 bundler wallets with a 47.7% top-bundler trader share, a 39% bot/degen rate and a 32-wallet insider trade network. There are 794 unique buyers against only 60 sellers, and no smart-money or KOL wallets.
authenticity.uncertainty: Some buyers may be real people who mistook this for the main token. X was not readable directly.

structural_risks: 100% of LP is unlocked on a direct PumpSwap pool (the creator can pull liquidity)
Creator already closed its position; the creator has launched 2 tokens
Bundlers hold a large share and there is a 32-wallet insider network
Copycat of a $17M token, so it depends on the canonical coin's momentum

structured_output.counterargument: When the canonical coin is running hard, low-cap copies with the same name can catch overflow buyers and 2-3x quickly. 794 unique buyers in 12 minutes is real flow, and liquidity ($38k) is above market cap, so there is room to run.
unknowns: Contents of the Beff Jezos tweet (X returned 402)
Whether any call channels are pushing this copy

structured_output.thesis: A bundled copycat of a hot $17M canonical token, with unlocked LP and a creator who has already exited. It carries a high rug risk and has a low chance of a clean 2x before -50%.
